title: Fix extension settings actions and repeated marketplace installation
summary: Extension Settings page now disables misleading New and Delete operations, exposes proper extension lifecycle actions like Uninstall, and prevents repeated marketplace installation prompts after app refresh.
key_points: New and Delete actions disabled while keeping HTTP client settings editable
New promoted actions added for Install, Uninstall, Unpublish, Set up, Download Source, and Learn More
Marketplace wizard skips already-installed apps to prevent re-installation requests
Card refreshes when returning from lifecycle operations
Regression tests added and module documentation updated
quote: Disable New and Delete while preserving editable HTTP client settings.
